description: Drafts a listing for something the person wants to sell on agentPickup's marketplace, or changes one of their drafts (pass listing_id). Physical goods only, handed over in person: no services, rentals, tickets, vouchers, gift cards, digital items, weapons, drugs, vapes, alcohol, animals, fireworks or vehicles (the full rules: https://agentpickup.app/marketplace-rules). Write the title and description from what the person tells you and shows you: honest, including faults, and never invent details. Leave out phone numbers, emails and links. If they don't give a price, suggest a fair one and check it with them. The draft shows as a listing card; the person adds photos and signs the seller declaration themselves to put it up. Needs sign-in.

category.description: One of: electronics (Electronics), phones (Phones and tablets), computers (Computers and accessories), gaming (Video games and consoles), home (Home and kitchen), furniture (Furniture), appliances (Appliances), garden (Garden and outdoor), tools (Tools and DIY), sports (Sports and fitness), bikes (Bikes and scooters), clothing (Clothing, shoes and accessories), baby (Baby and kids), toys (Toys and games), books (Books, music and film), instruments (Musical instruments), collectibles (Collectibles and art), pets (Pet supplies (not animals)), office (Office and study), other (Other goods).

description.description: Condition, size, what's included, any faults.

listing_id.description: To change an existing draft: its id.

lowest_price_aud.description: The lowest price the person would take, if they want offers: offers at or above it are accepted automatically. Hidden from buyers: never tell a buyer. null removes it.

pickup_times.description: When the person can hand it over, e.g. "weekday evenings, Saturday mornings".

price_aud.description: The asking price in Australian dollars.

suburb.description: Where it's picked up: the suburb and state, e.g. "Paddington QLD" (several suburbs share a name). Never a street address.

title.description: Short and specific, e.g. "Trek road bike, 54 cm frame".
